## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ded595a92e2214962e29cc13288ebc816e93e618`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (L21–31 claim, lapse, tie, hold, owed list; L56–60 waiting label), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md (L12–15 routing), scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_KEY`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_TEMPLATE`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_LAPSE_HOURS`, `readContractReviewClaim`, `contractReviewClaimLapse`, `contractReviewClaims` and the claim-line battery), scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs (header, `parseArgs`, `main`, `ownAccountsOf` and the review-seat bar), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS row, 120-byte cap), scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs (`PROSE_SURFACES`), scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs (pattern), scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh (needs:contract-review note), review record 6561911910 on PR #28759 — all read, none reviewed.

Inputs: card #28763 body and its two comments (triage 6684759750, claim 6692775528); PR #31034 body, file list (one file, +2/−2) and the net diff against `main` (merge-base `41dc30249`) at the head; the check-runs on the head. Remainder of the diff outside `hits`: none — the whole diff is the rules face (`.claude/**`, Tier S).

### ① Derived judgments

What L44–45 now instruct a patrolling seat, each against the tool and the rule text it cites:

- L44 「每席巡查跑 `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 取欠审清单」 — the script exists at that path; its usage is `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs [--repo OWNER/NAME] [--board OWNER/NAME] [--now ISO] [--json]`, report-only, exit 0, default repo `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. Run bare it reads the same repository the old label search read (the label is main-repo-only per `ensure-pm-labels.sh`). It lists every open PR, drafts included, owing on any face (`schema` / `rules` / `narrowing` / `declaration` / `clause2-unreadable` / `label`), with record, hand-off, claim, hold, lane and review-seat columns. That is the list contract-review.md L25 names. Right, with two should-fixes below (the invocation lacks `node`; the line does not say which rows are taken).
- L44 「剔除本账户署名的 PR」 — kept verbatim. Right (see ③).
- L45 「复核前落 `Contract-review-claim:` 行」 — the key is spelled exactly as `CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_KEY` plus its colon, as contract-review.md L27 spells it. A `Claim:` comment no longer appears, so the claim a reviewer posts under the runbook is the one `readContractReviewClaim` reads and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` prints as `HELD`. Right.
- L45 「形、失效、双认照 `contract-review.md`」 — form = L27 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_TEMPLATE`, pinned there verbatim by the record-recognisers self-test), 失效 = L28 head moved or 2 h (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_CLAIM_LAPSE_HOURS` = 2), 双认 = L28 先贴者持有 (`contractReviewClaims`: earliest posted holds). The three words are the words L28 uses. Right.
- L45 「有活认领 ⛔ 不双做」 — matches contract-review.md L26 (现 head 有记录或活认领 ⇒ 不起) and the script's `HELD` status. Right.
- Gates that read this prose: the line ratchet (CEILINGS row 245; head 245 lines, net 0; L44 116 B, L45 119 B, cap 120 B, file max 120 B at L65, untouched); `check:pm-governed-prose` regions are AGENTS.md and SKILL.md only, so the runbook is not parsed and the new spans hold no `**` glob anyway; `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (`#` + 3 digits) finds none in the new lines. No self-test pins the old strings: `git grep` at the head finds `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review` only in an `ensure-pm-labels.sh` comment and `同账户亦然` nowhere.
- Note, not a finding: the PR body's "109 / 120 → 116 / 119 bytes" counts the newline on the `main` side only. Measured without it, `main` is 108 / 119 B and the head 116 / 119 B. Both sides are under the cap either way.
- Gates on the head: read below ④. None red, seven in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

Nothing publishes: one `.claude/**` file, no package, `exports`, schema, CLI or docs path. `skip-changeset` is on the PR and `Check Changeset` concluded `success`. The body's `Clause-②: no` is right (no accept set moves) and so is `Metadata-protocol: none` (no metadata an author writes changes). Both are right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dropped 「(同账户亦然)」 — **covered, no rule lost.** The old line keyed the skip on a claim by 他席 and added 同账户亦然 so that two seats of one account could not both pass. The new line keys it on a 活认领 with no seat or account qualifier. Every layer the line now points at agrees: contract-review.md L26 says any record or live claim on the head ⇒ do not start, and L28's 双认 rule applies to any two claimants. `contractReviewClaims` keys a claim on its session and posting time and never reads an account (the signature only sets the triage, review or lane `side`). `check-owed-reviews.mjs` prints `HELD` on any live claim. So a sibling seat's claim on the same account blocks. The new rule is stricter than 他席: it also stops a fresh session of the same seat until the claim lapses, which closes the edge record 6561911910 SF-1 named. Lapse is the one narrowing: a claim lapsed by a moved head or 2 h no longer blocks, where the old wording blocked on any claim forever. That is contract-review.md L28's own rule. It drops no rule the runbook owned.
- Tie rule: the card body says "the lane seat wins ties". The rule text and code at the head say the earliest posted claim holds, a review seat and a lane seat alike, and only a legacy `triage#N` claim yields (`contractReviewClaims`; lanes/review.md L13). The runbook spells neither and defers to contract-review.md, so the card's stale paraphrase was not carried in. Right.
- Account-keyed self-exclusion survives, and the runbook must still carry it. `check-owed-reviews.mjs` does not know who runs it. Its only account logic (`ownAccountsOf`: attribution login plus the card `Claim:` signer) bars `review#N` seats from the taker column. It never drops a row for the running seat's account. Record 6561911910 ④ judged the account key right, and nothing here changes that.
- Dev deviations / open_questions: none raised in the PR body. The claim comment's tier waiver is the dispatching seat's statement, not read as an input here.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` ⇒ no author note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈巡查常设项〉 L44–45, judged against the card's two wanted lines (SF-1, SF-2 of record 6561911910) and the patrol it teaches.

- One spelling of the claim — holds. L45 names the key once and gives no second form (no fields, no `Claim:`, no session or account parenthetical). Form, lapse and tie are pointed at contract-review.md, the file the record-recognisers self-test pins against. The card's wanted L45 is met.
- Full owed list — holds. L44 reads the script, not the label alone, so face-owed PRs without the label, hand-offs, holds and lapsed claims all reach the patrol. The card's wanted L44 is met, with the self-exclusion kept.
- Line budget — holds: net 0 (245 → 245, CEILINGS 245), 116 B and 119 B against the 120 B cap.

Findings (none must-fix):

- **should-fix 1** — L44 「取欠审清单」 says what to read but not which rows to take. The label search listed labelled PRs, and a label is trigger (a), so every row it listed was takeable. The script lists every owing PR, including `WAIT` rows: the lane's own head inside its first round, or a head under a live `Contract-review-hold:` that holds (b). It also names a taker on `TAKE` rows, a seated review seat first and the lane only after a further round (lanes/review.md L14). A seat reading L44–45 alone could claim a held or first-round head. L46 「复核照 `contract-review.md`」 and contract-review.md L23–30 still bind, so this is not a FAIL. Suggested fix: name `TAKE` rows in L44, for example ``- 跨账户复审:每席巡查跑 `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`,TAKE 行剔除本账户署名的 PR。`` (113 B, net 0). That also carries should-fix 2.
- **should-fix 2** — 「跑 `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`」 is not a runnable command. The file is mode 100644, so run as written it fails with a permission error. The script's own usage, every `package.json` entry and the other pm-dispatch references spell it `node scripts/pm/…`. contract-review.md L25 can name the bare path because it names a list there, not a command. Add `node` (fits within the cap only with the rewording above).
- Observation, no finding: `ensure-pm-labels.sh` (needs:contract-review note) still names "each seat's patrol" as a reader of the `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review` filter. It also says no patrol script reads the label, while `check-owed-reviews.mjs` reads it as the `label` face. That note is outside this card's file surface and is pre-existing on `main` in its second half. Worth one line on a later skills card.
- Observation, no finding: L45 puts posting the claim before the live-claim check, the reverse of contract-review.md L26 (read, then claim). The 双认 rule it cites settles the case: the later claimant withdraws. The old line had the same order.

Gate read (head check-runs, 2026-11-06T19:05Z, 43 runs): 14 `completed / success` (among them Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Type Check · workspace, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate); 22 `skipped` by path; 0 `failure`. 7 `in_progress` at the read, not awaited: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates. Landing still needs these green (contract-review.md L51).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cdf61f36c614bf79bfa8b5bb36fae7f46b6c3129`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md + scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs (`owedReviewRow` status L333, `STATUS_ORDER` L403, `owedReviewRows`, `renderRow`, `renderReport` L469, `takerOf`, usage and file mode), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md (L23–31), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md (L14), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (CEILINGS row, 120-byte cap) — all read, none reviewed.

Delta review of one commit, `cdf61f36c` on top of `ded595a92`, the head of the earlier record by this reviewer. Merge-base with `main` is still `41dc30249`, so no rebase. Inputs: `git diff ded595a92 cdf61f36c` (one line, L44), the net diff against `main` at the new head (one file, +2/−2), the updated PR body, the head's check-runs, and the seat's local gates file for this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- L44 now reads 「每席巡查跑 `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`,TAKE 行剔除本账户署名的 PR」. The literal is the script's own status vocabulary. `owedReviewRow` sets `status = triggers.length > 0 ? 'TAKE' : 'WAIT'` (L333) once a current record (`DONE`) and a live claim (`HELD`) are ruled out. `STATUS_ORDER` is exactly `TAKE, WAIT, HELD, DONE` (L403, pinned by the self-test 「the status vocabulary stays exactly four」). `renderRow` opens each printed row with the status (`TAKE  #N …`), and `renderReport`'s summary counts `TAKE` as "to take" (L469). `--json` carries the same string in `status`. Spelling and case match. Right.
- The meaning matches too. `TAKE` = owed, no record, no live claim, and trigger (a), (b) or (c) holds. A live `Contract-review-hold:` suppresses (b) only, so a held or first-round head prints `WAIT` and is no longer taken. This is contract-review.md L23–30. The earlier record's should-fix 1 is closed.
- `node` prefix: the script is still mode 100644 at this head, and `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` is the script's own usage line. The earlier record's should-fix 2 is closed.
- The PR body is now accurate. It says `WAIT` stays with the lane and `HELD` / `DONE` need nothing, which matches L333. The byte figures `108 / 119 → 113 / 119` are measured without the newline and agree with this record's measurement. That closes the earlier note on the byte line.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged. Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset` is on the PR, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are in the body, and only one `.claude/**` file changes. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No regression from the earlier record. L45 is byte-identical to the reviewed head, so the claim key `Contract-review-claim:`, the 形、失效、双认 deferral and 「有活认领 ⛔ 不双做」 all stand as judged. The same-account case remains covered and no rule was lost. 「剔除本账户署名的 PR」 is kept verbatim, and the script still does no runner-keyed exclusion (`check-owed-reviews.mjs` is byte-identical between the two heads), so the runbook must keep carrying it, and it does.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` ⇒ no author note owed.
- The seat's local gates file for this head (17 commands, all `exit 0`) is byte-identical to its file for the previous head. I read it as the seat's statement and verified none of it. This verdict rests on the head's check-runs below.

### ④ Design judgment

- One spelling of the claim — holds (L45 untouched).
- Full owed list, with the rows the patrol acts on named — holds. The patrol runs the full list and takes the rows the list itself marks takeable. A literal reading can no longer take a held head or a lane's first-round head.
- Line budget — holds: 245 → 245 lines (CEILINGS 245, net 0). L44 is 113 B and L45 119 B against the 120 B cap. The file maximum is still 120 B at L65, untouched. The new lines hold no `#` + 3-digit ID and no `**` glob.

Findings: none must-fix, none should-fix.

- Observation, no finding: a `TAKE` row also names its taker (`take: …`), review seat first per lanes/review.md L14. L44 does not repeat "taken by this seat". The taker is printed on the same row the line points at, L46 「复核照 `contract-review.md`」 binds it, and 7 spare bytes cannot carry the clause. Leave it.

Gate read (head check-runs, 2026-11-06T19:16Z, 42 runs): 14 `completed / success`; 21 `skipped` by path; 0 `failure`. 7 `in_progress` at the read, not awaited: Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates. Landing still needs these green (contract-review.md L51).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `pm-dispatch` 运行手册〈巡查常设项〉两行:L44 改为跑 `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 取欠审清单、只接 `TAKE` 行并剔除本账户署名的 PR;L45 复核认领按键名 `Contract-review-claim:` 称呼，形、失效、双认交给 `contract-review.md`。1 个文件,+2/−2。
- **为什么改:** 旧 L44 只读 `needs:contract-review` 标签搜索，漏掉脚本列出的其他欠审 PR;旧 L45 自拼了一份认领格式，与 `contract-review.md`、`record-recognisers.mjs` 的写法分叉(#28763)。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 agent 内部文字,`.claude/**` 不发布、无 changeset;文件 245 行不变,L44 113 B、L45 119 B,均在 120 B 上限内。可整 PR revert。
- **先看:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` L44–45。
- **两分钟验证:** `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` 输出行首状态即 `TAKE` / `WAIT` / `HELD` / `DONE`,与 L44 用词一致。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。`.claude/**` 是 Tier S,同 head 达档 PASS 与全绿 CI 在案后由本席 ready + auto-merge。
- **席位意见:** ACCEPT。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:skills#3 · head `cdf61f36c614bf79bfa8b5bb36fae7f46b6c3129`

1. **形态:** draft → `main`,`Fixes #28763`;`skip-changeset`,`Clause-②: no`,`Metadata-protocol: none`;作者 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`;1 个文件，在认领面(L44–45)之内。
2. **前提实测:** 复核读 `check-owed-reviews.mjs`(`owedReviewRow` L333、`STATUS_ORDER` L403、汇总 L469)确认 `TAKE` 即可接行，持有中与车道首轮的 head 显示 `WAIT`;脚本不按运行账户剔除，故自剔句须留在手册;认领键与 `record-recognisers.mjs` 一致。
3. **门禁(钉 head `cdf61f36`):** dev 派生门禁 17 条全部 exit 0;check-runs 44 条全部完成,23 success、21 skip、0 failure。`check-governed-merges --pr 31034`:Tier S(`.claude/**`),4 行,低于人合阈值。复核：全量 6693126756 PASS(S1/S2),增量 6693334126 PASS,无发现。
4. **接受的偏差:** 无。
5. **范围外去向:** 无。`TAKE` 行另印接手人(复核席优先),L44 未复述，由 L46 引 `contract-review.md` 兜住，记录为观察非发现。
6. **落地条款:** Tier S。本席翻 ready 并开 auto-merge;红或踢出照 `landing-operations.md` 在本落地窗口处置。
